answer: A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, and thus it pays the pulse fee twice and still divides one payout. Because the haven ledger attributes every share, the marble audit makes public the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 63% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. That is 32 dollars per alias.
